content: Obesity is a risk factor for the development of several cancers, including breast, colon, and gynecological carcinomas.<sup>1,2</sup> Recently, it has been shown that obesity not only correlates with carcinogenesis but also influences the prognosis of patients with various cancers. For example, obesity has been correlated with a poor prognosis in breast<sup>3,4</sup> and colon cancers,<sup>5,6</sup> whereas a favorable prognosis has been reported in obese patients with gastric<sup>7</sup> or renal<sup>8</sup> cancers.
